speaker: Doctor

text: Since we've ruled out tuberculosis and systemic symptoms, have you noticed any wheezing or a "whooshing" sound in your chest when you breathe? Also, do you have a history of asthma or allergies? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray: Increased bronchial markings and mild peribronchial cuffing. No focal consolidations or pleural effusions.

speaker: Doctor
text: The chest X-ray shows signs of airway inflammation like peribronchial cuffing, but no pneumonia. Have you noticed any seasonal patterns to your symptoms, or do you have a history of allergies and eczema? Also, does your cough improve when you take antihistamines or decongestants?
